name: omnilab/earthdata
description: Omnilab Earthdata: NASA's Common Metadata Repository (CMR) - the granules of NASA's Earth observation collections (HLS, MODIS, VIIRS, GPM, SMAP, ICESat-2, OPERA...) as products by collection, point or box, period and cloud cover, page by page, with their footprints, attributes, browse images and files (https at the archive, s3 in AWS); the collections searched by text; open without an account, the files downloaded with an Earthdata Login token (an option).
